The possible three-pick sums come from selecting each time from \(\{2,4,8\}\).

Listing the distinct sums:

\[
\begin{aligned}
2+2+2&=6\\
2+2+4&=8\\
2+4+4&=10\\
2+2+8&=12\\
4+4+4&=12\\
2+4+8&=14\\
4+4+8&=16\\
2+8+8&=18\\
4+8+8&=20\\
8+8+8&=24
\end{aligned}
\]

So the distinct possible sums are

\[
6,8,10,12,14,16,18,20,24.
\]

Their sum is

\[
6+8+10+12+14+16+18+20+24=128.
\]

The answer is 128.
